channel.title: Gambali Seshasai Chaitanya
channel.description: Recent content on Gambali Seshasai Chaitanya

item.title: Design and Tapeout of a 64 Point FFT Module
item.description: Architected a low-area 64-point FFT module in Verilog, marking the first successful tapeout from IIT (BHU) Varanasi on SkyWater 130nm via TinyTapeout.

item.title: Real-Time Video Processing Pipeline on Pynq
item.description: Real-time 1080p hardware-accelerated video processing pipeline on Xilinx Pynq-Z2. AXI4-Stream pipeline with switchable Sobel, blur, and threshold kernels at 60fps.

item.title: FPGA-based Raw NAND Flash Controller
item.description: Bare-metal controller for direct Read/Write/Erase on raw 2D/3D SLC & MLC NAND Flash via ONFI. Built on Digilent Zybo (Verilog) and Altera DE1-SoC (Embedded Linux).

item.title: RISC-V CPU in Verilog HDL
item.description: 32-bit RV32IM CPU implemented in Verilog, validated via RTL testbenches and cross-compiled C benchmarks. Physical design flow targeting SkyWater 130nm tape-out.

item.title: Neural Network Inference on FPGAs
item.description: Hardware-accelerated Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) for edge inference on FPGA. Parameterized behavioural Verilog neuron model assembled into a fully-connected inference network.

item.title: Systolic Hardware Accelerator for Vector-Matrix Operations
item.description: Systolic array accelerator for matrix multiplications and convolutions, orchestrated via an AXI-4 interrupt-controlled interface. Awarded 2nd Prize at I-Chip, Udyam'24.
